title: Laragiya language
description: Endangered Darwin language spoken in Australia
extract: The Laragiya language, also spelt Larrakia, and also known as Gulumirrgin, is an Australian Aboriginal language spoken by just six people near the city of Darwin in northern Australia as of 1983. Only 41 people claimed to know the Laragiya language in 2021.
